message.content: Logistic regression is a statistical method used for binary classification problems. It models the probability that a given input belongs to one of two classes (e.g., success/failure, yes/no) by applying the logistic (sigmoid) function to a linear combination of the input features. The model’s parameters are typically estimated using maximum likelihood estimation, and the resulting coefficients indicate how each feature influences the log‑odds of the outcome.
